create_KUKA_robot: create a Kuka robot instance with default URDF path and time step for PyBullet simulation
reset_KUKA_robot: reset the Kuka robot to its initial joint positions and reload the SDF model and tray
get_action_dimension: get the action space dimension for the Kuka robot based on inverse kinematics or motor count
get_observation: get the Kuka robot end effector position and Euler angle orientation as a 6D observation vector
apply_action: apply motor commands to move the Kuka robot end effector by delta positions and control the gripper
